masteryHint: Cards you answer right in Recall, Spell and tests grow from seed to flower. Leaf and flower need a right answer on a later day, and studying again never shrinks them.
dueNone: Nothing to review today. Cards you got right come back after 1, 3, 7, 14 and 30 days.
dueClosed: The deadline has passed, so review is closed too.
missedBody: {count} cards you missed in the last 4 weeks. Get one right in review and it leaves the list.
dueIntro: These cards are due. A right answer pushes the next review further out; a miss brings the card back tomorrow.
missedIntro: Cards you missed before. The ones you get right leave the list.
noReviewBody: New misses and due cards will gather here.
reviewDoneBody: Every card you recall again stays with you longer.
reviewDropped: Some answers could not be saved. The set may be closed or past its deadline.
unmasteredHint: The share of students with any activity who have not yet reached leaf on this card (answered right again on a later day). Records from before mastery do not count.
noUnmastered: No activity yet, or every card is at leaf or above.
